_README: Single source of truth for facts shared across the AI-assistant onboarding files (AGENTS.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .codex/AGENTS.md, .cursorrules). Edit values HERE, then run `node tools/agentic-sync/sync.mjs --write` to propagate them into every target's AGENTIC-SYNC marker block. CI (scripts/check-agentic-sync.sh) fails any PR where a target drifts from this file. Scope: only facts that have no other authoritative home (taskboard IDs, pinned versions, coverage thresholds). Command count lives in the MCP manifest; do not duplicate it here.

facts.quickValidation: cd web && npx eslint --max-warnings 0 . && npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest run
